title: 第1344章 一物降一物第1343章 请外援
content_zh:
“我唤你来，是让你处理掉眼前的域外天魔！”吉恩咽了咽口水说道。
还好吉恩穿着探索者机甲，力嗷看不到吉恩的神色，要不然肯定要怀疑了！
甚至不需要怀疑，直接就能发现吉恩的境界。
“什么东西！又来一个乌龟壳？你不会以为加了一个乌龟壳，就能打败我吧？”松剑轻蔑的说道。
松剑也没有反应过来，自己突进的路上突然出现一个物品，想也没想用剑将其击飞了出去，不过这时候，祂的速度自然也慢了下来。
“域外天魔？域外天魔可不在我的业务范围内！”力嗷摇头说道。
对于松剑的嘲讽，力嗷并不在意，反正都不是一个世界的生物。
域外天魔分身无数，力嗷也是只听闻过，这还是第一次见到。
感觉也不是很强的样子～
但松剑的神魂还是将祂的话，传递到了两人神魂之中。
“不需要你击杀祂，你只要帮我阻挡祂就行了。如果能够将其击退，就算你完成了一个任务。”吉恩缓缓说道。
机甲视界上，一直显示小黑的话，沉住气稳住意。
不要让力嗷看出端倪！
因为现在行者号飞船上，没有仙阶修士，一旦力嗷看出端倪，那后果不堪设想。
他的破坏力，并不比域外天魔差，甚至犹有过之！
最主要的是，没有制约，谁也不知道力嗷会做出什么事来。
“这也算一个任务？”力嗷看着吉恩不解说道。
随着吉恩话毕，一连串的数据，导入到安保机器人的视界中，力嗷自然也看清楚了，知道这是个什么任务。
这算是什么任务？
这么简单？

这不会是什么阴谋吧？
比如再坑自己，奴役自己再做一百件事？
自己已经做了几件了，可不能再上当。
“自然！”吉恩点头说道。
“欺神太甚！”松剑喝道。
松剑发现两人，在自己面前自说自话，竟然将自己给无视了！
还有那个，什么叫做“这也算是任务”？
这是完全不将自己放在眼里？
这让自视甚高的松剑哪里忍得住气，一剑横削了过去，一道弧形信仰之力剑气，随之横扫而出。
等到两人跟前之时，已然是一道几百丈的巨型剑气，一路摧枯拉朽，将四周没有防御结界的建筑，齐齐拦腰切断。
只是因为速度太快，这些建筑的主体，都还没有来得及垮塌而已。
对于三维空间的能量攻击，安保机器人与探索者机甲，自然直接免疫了。
“好！记住你的话！给我打开力量权限！”力嗷说道。
力嗷第一句是对吉恩说的，第二句是对安保机器人ai说的。
“你权限不足！给予你5级力量权限，完全足够应付现在的困难。”……
“我…！呼～哼！等我出来后，第一个就将你给拆了！”力嗷冷声说道。
content_en:
"I called you here to let you deal with the extraterrestrial demon in front of you!" Gene swallowed and said.
Fortunately, Gene was wearing an Explorer mecha, and Li Ao couldn't see Gene's expression, otherwise he would have been suspicious!
You don't even need to doubt, you can directly discover Jean's realm.
"What! Another turtle shell? You don't think you can defeat me just by adding a turtle shell, do you?" Song Jian said contemptuously.
Song Jian didn't react. An object suddenly appeared on his way. He knocked it away with his sword without thinking, but at this time, his speed naturally slowed down.
"Extraterritorial demons? Extraterrestrial demons are not within the scope of my business!" Li Ao shook his head and said.
Li Ao didn't care about Song Jian's ridicule, since they were not creatures of the same world anyway.
There are countless clones of demons outside the territory, and Li Ao has only heard of them. This is the first time he has seen them.
It doesn’t feel very strong~
But Song Jian's soul still conveyed his words to the two souls.
"You don't need to kill him, you just need to help me stop him. If you can repel him, you have completed a mission." Jean said slowly.
Xiao Hei's words are always displayed on the mecha's vision, keep calm and steady your mind.
Don't let Li Ao see the clues!
Because there are no immortal-level monks on the Walker spacecraft now, once Li Ao sees the clues, the consequences will be disastrous.
His destructive power is no worse than that of the demon from outside the territory, it is even more powerful!
The most important thing is that without restrictions, no one knows what Li Ao will do.
"Is this considered a mission?" Li Ao looked at Jean and asked in confusion.
As Jean finished speaking, a series of data was imported into the security robot's vision. Li Ao naturally saw it clearly and knew what the mission was.
What kind of mission is this?
So simple?
Isn't this some kind of conspiracy?
How about tricking yourself again and enslaving yourself to do another hundred things?
I’ve already made a few of them, so I can’t be fooled again.
"Of course!" Gene nodded.
"It's too much to deceive the gods!" Song Jian shouted.
Song Jian found that the two of them were talking to themselves in front of him, but they actually ignored him!
And what does "this is also a task" mean?
Does this mean you don’t take yourself seriously at all?
This made Song Jian, who thought highly of himself, unable to hold back his anger. He slashed across with his sword, and an arc-shaped sword energy of faith swept out.
When the two of them came forward, there was already a giant sword energy of several hundred feet, destroying everything along the way, cutting off all the buildings without defensive barriers around them.
Just because the speed was too fast, the main bodies of these buildings had not had time to collapse.
Security robots and explorer mechas are naturally immune to energy attacks in three-dimensional space.
"Okay! Remember your words! Open the power permissions for me!" Li Ao said.
The first sentence Li Ao said was to Jean, and the second sentence was to the security robot AI.
"You don't have enough authority! Giving you level 5 power authority is completely enough to cope with the current difficulties."...
"I...! Huh! When I come out, I will be the first to tear you apart!" Li Ao said coldly.
